Game.title: Game
Game.description: Represents an individual Tic-Tac-Toe match session.

gameCode.description: Short code used for joining the game.

mode.description: Game mode: against Minimax AI or player-versus-player.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the game.

createdBy.description: UID of the user who initiated the game match.

playerOUid.description: UID of Player O or 'ai' or empty.

currentTurn.description: Whose turn it currently is to move.

winner.description: Winner of the match if finished, otherwise none.

eventCount.description: Total number of committed events in the event-sourced log.

aiDifficulty.description: Difficulty configuration for the Minimax algorithm.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last game update.

GameEvent.title: GameEvent
GameEvent.description: An immutable event representing a turn action or rollback in the event log.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number of this event.

type.description: Type of event: a piece placement or a time-travel rollback.

targetTurnNumber.description: Turn index to restore back to when type is ROLLBACK.

byUid.description: UID of the player triggering the event.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the event was recorded.

/games/{gameId}.description: Root collection storing metadata and current cached summary of Tic-Tac-Toe games.

/games/{gameId}/events/{eventId}.description: Subcollection storing append-only event stream of all moves and rollback actions for event sourcing.
